New listing (Published: May 20, 2026)

The Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association will close its information desk (including phone inquiries) on Saturday, June 6 and Sunday, June 7, 2026 (Reiwa 8) due to regular facility maintenance at the Hanno Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

On these dates, we will not be able to sell Eagle Bus passes or distribute manhole cards. However, Puratto Hanno (Hanno Station Tourist Information Desk, Tel. 042-978-9111, open 9:00–17:00) will operate as usual.
